title: Emotive Blocks
description: Bring New Features to the Blocks in Your Game with the Death Totem
body:
### A meteor fell… and emotions awakened.
### 

Many years ago, a meteorite crashed into the world and infused emotions into ordinary blocks.
Now the earth cries, laughs, hides, melts, and even plays music.
Every emotional block has its own personality, unique reactions, _hidden achievements, and secrets to discover._

**If you interact with them carefully, you might uncover what the meteor truly changed…**
![Sad Stone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f96bd1994dbbf60aa24818f5a0dba2f1bc9db46_0.webp)

### Sad Stone
### 
A lonely stone that cries when touched.
Right-click it, and the tears grow louder.
**(Heating SadStone turns it into smooth stone.)**
![Angry Dirt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4fe9e2f384de7fc9b841a1cbf6542e90db3afbf2.png)

### Angry Dirt

In a constant bad mood.
Right-clicking might not calm it down, but at least you can try.
Chamomile tea recommended.
![Happy Grass](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf07084901f83e650113f05263f3d8287cac201b_0.webp)

### Happy Grass

Cheerful and calm…
Until you ruin its hairstyle with a hoe.
**(Hoeing HappyGrass unlocks a hidden advancement!)**
![Shy Sand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ffb59fd99adaef89bbc8c4a2547dbf35efbfd7b_0.webp)

### Shy Sand

Extremely shy.
It hides inside itself when clicked — but now there’s more to discover:

Brushing ShySand turns it into Suspicious Sand
Suspicious Sand drops 3x “Grains of Sand”
Right-clicking a normal sand block with Grains of Sand transforms it into Suspicious Sand

**Giving Grains of Sand to Detective Clay unlocks a hidden achievement
(Heating ShySand turns it into Glass.**
![Detective Clay](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57317d72ee23841aa81a32ea3b5932731b531926_0.webp)

### Detective Clay

A skeptical block with a mysterious sound.
Brush right-click to possibly find:

Immortality Totem
Redstone
Clay

**And receives Grains of Sand to trigger a secret achievement.
(Heating turns it into Terracotta.**
![Melting Ice](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3c9254de0ac8272ffbae088f1fa2a7f69f3b291_0.webp)

### Melting Ice

Afraid of fire.
Any fire spell, lighter or flame causes instant melting.
May it live happily during its last seconds…
![Note Flute](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/979545a7aa640ba62509af4be21902cd6a147795_0.webp)

### NoteFlute

Right-click to play flute notes.
**Join a one-block symphony.**
![Warm Coal / Exploding TNT / Haunted Blackstone / Stuck Cobbled Deepslate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f43eba9e96a37f273ccc7c7e8c8a60a27cfc823.png)

### Warm Coal

A hot-headed block.
Right-clicking gives temporary Fire Resistance,
but trying to break it can make it angry… and burn everything.
### Exploding TNT

A bomb waiting for one touch.
9 out of 10 doctors recommend not touching it.
### Haunted Blackstone

It doesn’t want anyone nearby.
Nobody knows why… yet. responds as it approaches
### Stuck Cobbled Deepslate

It has been stuck for a very long time.
It slows you down when you stand on it.
**(Heating it returns it to Deepslate.)**
![Cool Gold Block / Magical Lapis Block / Duck White Wool / Guard Iron](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c6d61680bde2c2d305aaaa44b22a7f228f2c783_0.webp)

### Cool Gold Block

It’s cool. It knows it’s cool. It shines in style.
### Magical Lapis Block

Gives you XP.
**But what else can it do?**
### Duck White Wool

Makes a sweet sound when right-clicked.
### Guard Iron
A protective and loyal block — it shields those it trusts.
**Right-clicking grants Absorption II,**
Its iron shell hides a soft emotional core
![Scary Pumpkin / Hiding Brick / Eaten Bamboo / Sleepy Hay Bale](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/365d6b13c1314d3df95325442ff5195735d0d3fa.png)

### Scary Pumpkin

Looks so sweet.
**Right-clicking might be the mistake of your life.**

### Hiding Brick
A block that hides you too.
Right-click → short Invisibility
Placing this block unlocks a hidden advancement
 
### Eaten Bamboo
Someone was hungry…
Right-click to eat!

**Placing this block unlocks a hidden advancement**

Heating → Coal Block
### Sleepy Hay Bale

Just as sleepy as it looks.
Right-click → Bread
**(Why? No one knows.)**
![Emotive Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f29bbc9f0f06ba4c239c7fc8f76ffa53554d8979_0.webp)

### Conversions & Discoveries

Heating Emotional Blocks creates new materials:

_SadStone → smooth stone_

_Detective Clay → Terracotta_

_Eaten Bamboo → Coal Block_

_Stuck Cobbled Deepslate → Deepslate_

_ShySand → Glass_

Each emotional block has its own recipe with the Immortal Totem and its corresponding Main Block.

### Features
### 
Each block is fully animated

Every update adds new emotional blocks

Discover hidden achievements

Unlock mysteries behind the meteor

Personality-based reactions

Secret interactions with tools and magic

**A growing emotional ecosystem**
